mapper.select: SELECT ja.id as application_id, as2.schedule_id, j.id as job_id, j.title as job_title, ja.worker_id, w.worker_name, w.worker_phone, js.schedule_date, js.start_time, js.end_time, ja.status, ja.applied_at FROM job_applications ja JOIN application_schedules as2 ON ja.id = as2.application_id JOIN job_schedules js ON as2.schedule_id = js.id JOIN jobs j ON ja.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN c_worker w ON ja.worker_id = w.id WHERE j.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY ja.applied_at DESC

SELECT ja.id as application_id, as2.schedule_id, j.id as job_id, j.title as job_title, ja.worker_id, w.worker_name, w.worker_phone, js.schedule_date, js.start_time, js.end_time, ja.status, ja.applied_at FROM job_applications ja JOIN application_schedules as2 ON ja.id = as2.application_id JOIN job_schedules js ON as2.schedule_id = js.id JOIN jobs j ON ja.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN c_worker w ON ja.worker_id = w.id WHERE j.id = #{jobId} ORDER BY ja.applied_at DESC

SELECT ja.id as application_id, as2.schedule_id, j.id as job_id, j.title as job_title, ja.worker_id, w.worker_name, w.worker_phone, js.schedule_date, js.start_time, js.end_time, ja.status, ja.applied_at FROM job_applications ja JOIN application_schedules as2 ON ja.id = as2.application_id JOIN job_schedules js ON as2.schedule_id = js.id JOIN jobs j ON ja.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN c_worker w ON ja.worker_id = w.id WHERE j.id = #{jobId} AND ja.status = #{status} ORDER BY ja.applied_at DESC
